caption: The drawing depicts a dress on a torso form without a head, arms, or legs. The main dress is colored in a bright red tone and features a pattern of small, geometric shapes in yellow, blue, green, and white, with black accents. The dress has short sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a wide, full skirt that appears to be layered with a scalloped hemline. The neckline is wide and rounded. In the background, to the upper right of the main dress, there is a smaller, uncolored outline of the same dress, showing the same general shape, short sleeves, fitted bodice, and full skirt with layered scalloped hem. The paper background is light beige with faint brownish stains at the corners and a small pink marking at the bottom.
title: Child's Dress
